question_text: Describe the difference between conceptual and logical database schemas.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: A conceptual schema gives a high-level view of entities and relationships. A logical schema specifies their structure in more detail, including attributes and keys, without choosing physical storage implementation.
